final: WITH color_averages AS (SELECT p.product_color, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost) AS color_average FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY p.product_color), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(color_average) AS value FROM color_averages), kept_colors AS (SELECT c.product_color, c.color_average, c.color_average - o.value AS excess FROM color_averages AS c CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE c.color_average > o.value), kept_average AS (SELECT AVG(color_average) AS value FROM kept_colors) SELECT k.product_color, k.color_average, k.excess, k.color_average - a.value FROM kept_colors AS k CROSS JOIN kept_average AS a WHERE k.color_average > a.value
